{'empty': False, 'text': "Apple has announced it will extend free satellite connectivity for existing iPhone users by another year, as noted in a footnote of the iPhone 18 Pro press release. Here's what you need to know."}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'Apple Confirms New Extension'}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'Apple first introduced satellite connectivity with the iPhone 14 lineup, initially offering Emergency SOS via satellite and the ability to share your location via Find My through satellite. At launch, Apple said the service would be free for two years.'}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'Since then, Apple has expanded its satellite services, adding features like Roadside Assistance via satellite and Messages via satellite. Apple now refers to these collectively as satellite features.'}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'In November 2023, Apple extended free Emergency SOS via satellite for existing iPhone 14 users by an additional year. Last year, Apple extended it again, this time covering existing iPhone 14 and iPhone 15 users.'}

{'empty': False, 'text': "Without an extension, some users would have seen their free service expire later this year. But in a footnote of yesterday's iPhone 18 Pro press release, Apple announced that free service would be extended for another year—and for the first time, existing iPhone 16 users would also be covered."}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'The original press release text reads:'}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'Since Apple includes one year of free satellite features for every new iPhone buyer, those purchasing a new iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo will get one year free, while existing iPhone 14, iPhone 15, and iPhone 16 users covered by the extension will also receive an additional year at no cost.'}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'Apple has not yet announced pricing for after the free period ends. Given that these features could be life-or-death, many suspect Apple may ultimately keep at least some of them free, as charging for emergency services could be controversial.'}

{'empty': False, 'text': "Regardless, free service has been extended for another year. Whether this is the final extension or whether we'll be writing a similar story again next year remains to be seen."}

{'empty': False, 'text': 'What do you think—will Apple eventually charge for satellite features? Share your thoughts in the comments.'}
